verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow and durable-execution platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a Temporal MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. The llms.txt index, the CLI and the AI SDK integrations are adjacent features, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
